_comment: End-of-life data for server-side technologies disclosed in HTTP response headers (Server, X-Powered-By). Distinct from library_eol.json, which covers client-side JS/CSS libraries detected in page HTML. Same schema shape so _annotate_eol() in audit_checks.py can consume both. Versions here are keyed major.minor because server-runtime lifecycles (PHP, Python, etc.) differ by minor version, not just major. Dates are authoritative end-of-life (no security patches) dates from each project's official lifecycle page.

php._note: php.net/supported-versions. 4-year lifecycle (2yr active + 2yr security). 8.1 EOL 2025-12-31; 8.2 EOL 2026-12-31 (security-only now); 8.3/8.4/8.5 supported. Everything 8.0 and below is EOL.

asp.net._note: ASP.NET Framework versions exposed via X-AspNet-Version. The classic .NET Framework 1.x-3.x are long dead; 4.x is the last Framework line (supported as part of Windows). This covers the classic X-AspNet-Version disclosures, which almost always indicate old WebForms apps.
